title: Propheta's letters to Jim Garrison in the Garrison files
place_text: New Orleans, Louisiana; the Bronx, New York

tellings.quote: where the leader of the church, guy called Propheta, was writing letters to Jim Garrison saying, "When you're finished with Jack Martin, can you send him back to us?" Right.

plain: In the 1960s, the leader of a small church in the Bronx, a man called Propheta, is said to have written to Jim Garrison, the New Orleans district attorney who investigated President Kennedy's assassination. Propheta was asking about Jack Martin, a man caught up in Garrison's investigation: "When you're finished with Jack Martin, can you send him back to us?" A writer on occult and secret history named Peter Levenda describes the letters, which he says sit in Garrison's correspondence files. If true, they link a figure in the Kennedy case to a strange little church.
